As an FDE, you are embedded directly on the frontlines with top global advertisers, agencies, and enterprise clients. You will lead technical discovery, design custom onboarding architectures, build AI automations, and own the conversion of 3-month product trial discoveries into long-term commercial adoption. You will act as a hybrid technical expert, AI practitioner, and strategic consultant, serving as the core engine powering our product's structural moat. * ### **Account Executive - (AdTech / MarTech / SaaS)**

  + Department: Sales
  + Location: United Kingdom, England, London
  + Creation date: 2026-08-21

  We are looking for a motivated **SaaS Account Executive** to accelerate our expansion in the EMEA region. You'll be responsible for overseeing the entire sales cycle, with support from a team of Sales Development Representatives and Sales Engineers.

  This is a **full-time position** based in London on hybrid basis. 3 Days a week in our Offices.
    
    
  The target compensation package is £110k–£150k OTE on a 50:50 split (£55k–£75k base).

  ### **Some of the things you’ll work on:**

  + Influence and **engage decision-makers** regarding their marketing data and analytics strategy and operations.
  + Create, maintain, close and continually **develop a pipeline focused primarily on businesses in the EMEA** region within a variety of verticals.
  + **Build relationships** via email, phone and B2B networks, events and face-to-face meetings.
  + Collaborate with marketing, product and security teams to ensure **effective communication** and follow-up on leads in your pipeline.
  + Partner with solutions consultants and engineers to **develop customised solutions that meet customers' needs**.
  + **Demonstrate Adverity's solution and capabilities to potential customers** through a strategic deal process including demos, POCs, and other sales activities.
  + Consistently maintain HubSpot CRM to **track opportunities and activities**, while providing accurate forecasting and reporting of activity.

  ### **We’re excited if you have:**

  + Previous successful experience as a **consultative solution seller in the SaaS** (martech/adtech/data analytics) industry, where you have met or exceeded your targets.
  + Knowledge of the **data, measurement, or marketing landscape**.
  + Excellent **negotiating skills** with a positive demeanour. Success-oriented, proactive and self-motivated mindset.
  + Ability to take an **experimental approach to the sales process** and thrive in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment.
  + Desire to **learn and stay up-to-date on technology trends**, developments & best practices.
  + Strong **project management** skills is a plus.
* ### **Account Manager - (AdTech / MarTech / SaaS)**

  + Department: Account Management
  + Location: United Kingdom, England, London
  + Creation date: 2026-10-06

  As a strategic commercial partner, the Account Manager is responsible for securing and expanding a high-value portfolio by guiding customers along their data maturity journey and uncovering new revenue opportunities.

  Through a deep understanding of customer objectives, the role positions Adverity as a critical enabler of strategic business outcomes—not just a platform provider.

  By consistently demonstrating measurable ROI and influencing executive stakeholders, the Account Manager plays a pivotal role in turning customer partnerships into long-term, revenue-generating growth engines.

  This is a **full-time** position based in our London Office working on a hybrid basis.
    
    
  **Base Salary Range:** £**60,000 – £80,000**

  **Variable Compensation (OTE):** Target of **£32,000 gross per annum**, capped at £25,000 per quarter

  ### **Some of the things you’ll work on:**

  + Drive revenue growth through strategic upsells and cross-sells, aligning Adverity’s evolving capabilities (e.g., AI analytics, Data Quality) with customer pain points.
  + Proactively identify commercial opportunities within your portfolio, turning business challenges into expansion conversations.
  + Build and deliver compelling, data-backed business cases that connect product functionality to measurable ROI and strategic business outcomes.
  + Consistently exceed Net Revenue Retention (NRR) targets by unlocking new revenue streams and minimizing contraction.
  + Position Adverity as a critical pillar in the customer’s data strategy, steering conversations away from features and toward long-term value.
  + Own the commercial execution of your accounts end-to-end—from opportunity spotting to deal closing and internal alignment.
  + Build deep, multi-threaded relationships with executive stakeholders to secure influence and elevate commercial positioning.
  + Anticipate renewal risks early and neutralize churn threats with value reinforcement and competitive differentiation.
  + Maintain rigorous CRM documentation to support account planning, forecasting, and stakeholder visibility.
  + Champion the customer’s voice across internal teams to ensure our roadmap and services fuel commercial expansion and retention.

  ### **We’re excited if you have:**

  + Proven track record of driving revenue expansion in SaaS, ideally in a Data Platform or AdTech / MarTech environment.
  + Strong sales instincts with demonstrated success in identifying, developing, and closing expansion, upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  + Skilled in crafting persuasive business cases and commercial narratives tied to customer KPIs and ROI outcomes.
  + Deep understanding of enterprise buying cycles, commercial drivers, and stakeholder motivations.
  + Comfortable engaging and influencing executive-level stakeholders and economic buyers to drive deal progression.
  + Experience navigating complex accounts and multi-threaded relationships to accelerate commercial outcomes.
  + Strong financial and strategic acumen—able to link data and product features to top-line impact.
  + Proficiency in CRM and success tools (e.g., Gainsight), including forecasting, account planning, and stakeholder mapping.
  + Effective at using AI tools and modern productivity tech to streamline operations and focus on revenue-driving activities.
  + Self-directed and outcome-obsessed, with a relentless focus on growth.**Why you’ll love it here:**
  + Flexible working hours and home-office
  + Internal shares program (EDPP)
  + Regular team events
  + Sustainable merch for all employees
  + Adverity Social Responsibility Days (+1 day paid off)

* ### **Director, Content & Communications**

  + Department: Marketing
  + Location: United Kingdom, England, London
  + Creation date: 2026-07-01

  ### **Role summary**

  The Director, Content & Communications owns Adverity's content strategy, editorial direction, executive thought leadership, and PR/communications strategy end-to-end. The role leads a focused content team and is a working leader, hands-on with editorial direction, thought leadership programmes, and PR strategy, not just a strategic overseer.

  Primary accountability is category creation and market education, shaping how the market defines and talks about the space Adverity competes in, and building the market's understanding of the problem it solves.

  This is an agentic-first content leadership role: the Director is responsible for building and shaping the agentic systems and processes that support content, AEO optimisation, scheduling, and distribution.

  ### **Key responsibilities**

  + - Lead category creation — defining and driving the market narrative for the space Adverity competes in, and arming executive spokespeople to deliver it publicly
    - Lead market education — building the market's understanding of the problem Adverity solves, through explainer content, practitioner-level education, and analyst engagement
    - Own content strategy and editorial direction — the framework and standards flowing into campaigns, ABM, PMM, and thought leadership
    - Own PR and communications strategy — managing the external PR agency and earned media presence
    - Lead executive thought leadership programmes for senior spokespeople
    - Lead AEO strategy and share-of-voice growth through content, PR, and editorial output
    - Set editorial standards and quality bar for all written marketing output
    - Shape and evolve the agentic systems and processes supporting content, AEO optimisation, scheduling, and distribution

  ### **What you bring**

  + - Extensive experience in brand, content, or communications leadership in B2B SaaS
    - Demonstrable track record growing share of voice in a competitive category
    - Experience leading AEO, SEO, or AI-search visibility programmes at scale
    - Hands-on editorial chops — capable of setting voice and directing senior content and design talent at the working level
    - Experience managing PR agencies and securing tier-one earned media
    - Experience owning organic social and executive thought leadership programmes
    - Experience deploying AI and agentic tooling in a content production context

  As an FDE, you are embedded directly on the frontlines with top global advertisers, agencies, and enterprise clients. You will lead technical discovery, design custom onboarding architectures, build AI automations, and own the conversion of 3-month product trial discoveries into long-term commercial adoption. You will act as a hybrid technical expert, AI practitioner, and strategic consultant, serving as the core engine powering our product's structural moat.
    
    
  **Base Salary Range:** £65,000 – £90,000 + performance bonus

  ### **Some of the things you'll work on:**

  + Act as an embedded domain expert during onboarding of our newest AI product, helping customers reach value quickly. You will partner cross functionally with sales, product, engineering and account management to accelerate adoption and value for customers

* ### **Product Owner**

  + Department: Product Management
  + Location: Bulgaria, Sofia City Province, Sofia
  + Creation date: 2026-07-22

  We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Product Owner who thrives working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and turns customer, market and stakeholder signal into clear priorities. In this role, you will sit inside a product engineering team, alongside the lead and product engineers, shaping problem statements, backlog and sprint plans that the whole team believes in.

  This is a full-time role based in Sofia, Bulgaria. We value in person collaboration and meet in the office at least 3 times a week.

  ### **Some of the things you'll work on:**

  Bring outside context into the team, including customer feedback, support trends, usage data and competitive landscape.

  + Write clear, honest problem statements that a product engineer can pick up and run with.
  + Track outcomes after a feature ships, not just whether it ships.
  + Keep the backlog tidy and up to date in Jira, drafting new items and retiring stale ones.
  + Draft problem statements and acceptance criteria for new tickets, finishing acceptance criteria jointly with a product engineer where needed.
  + Run backlog grooming as a working session with product engineers.
  + Bring a clear "why it matters" into sprint planning and set the sprint goal together with the lead and product engineers.
  + Surface new signal that could shift priorities and work through trade-offs before committing to changes mid-sprint.
  + Shape and sequence the roadmap together with the lead and engineers, and own the "what problem is worth solving" call.
  + Join sprint reviews and demos to check delivered work against the original problem.

  ### **We're excited if you have:**

  + 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or similar role, with real day-to-day ownership of a backlog.
  + Hands-on experience running Jira, including writing tickets and running or co-running grooming sessions.
  + Comfort working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers rather than handing off finished specs.
  + Strong plain-language writing skills for problem statements and acceptance criteria.
  + Enough technical fluency to follow a trade-off conversation and ask the right questions.
  + A track record of prioritising under pressure, including saying no and explaining why.
  + Genuine curiosity about the "why" behind customer and business problems.
  + Familiarity with tools like Notion, Mixpanel or Amplitude for tracking outcomes post-launch.
  + Some direct customer-facing experience, such as support, sales engineering, customer success or research.**Why you'll love it here:**
  + Flexible working hours and home-office (2x per week)
  + Internal shares programme (EDPP)
  + Ergonomic workspace and cutting-edge technology
  + Regular team events
  + Modern and stylish offices
  + Sustainable merch for all employees
  + Adverity Social Responsibility Days (+2 days paid off)

  **Are you ready to apply?**

  Apply now if you are ready to revolutionise the way businesses work with marketing data.

  We look forward to meeting you!
* ### **Senior Full Stack Engineer (f/m/d)**

  + Department: Engineering
  + Location: Austria, Vienna, Vienna
  + Creation date: 2026-07-31

  We are looking for a **Senior Full Stack Engineer** (Senior Product Engineer) to own the technical direction and delivery of solutions in one of our teams. You aren’t just here to write code - you are a partner in the product journey, helping us shape architecture, refine the work breakdown, and advocate for performance and security at every step.

  This is a **full-time, hybrid position based in Vienna**. We value in-person collaboration, so regular office presence is a priority (3 times a week).

  ### **Some of the things you’ll do:**

  **In the first month:**

  + Get to **know your product development team** and get familiar with our products, technologies, systems & architecture, processes and practices.
  + Absorb our engineering culture, **start coding** and ramp-up quickly within the Adverity universe.
  + Get to know the **architecture and codebase** inside-out.

  **In the first 6 months:**

  + Support your product development team with **deep code reviews**, guiding them towards better system quality and engineering practices.
  + Participate in **shaping new features** by getting your hands dirty in PoCs, breaking down technical scopes, and commence working on team deliveries.

  **Beyond the first 6 months:**

  + At this point, you know the **Adverity platform very well**, both product and tech.
  + Participate in strategic **cross-product engineering initiatives** and help product development teams towards pragmatic technical decisions based on limited context, striving to constantly improve maintainability and reliability.
  + You **increase your impact beyond your product development team** to the whole engineering team & beyond.

  ### **We’re excited if you have:**

  + **Product-driven mindset:** a strong focus on understanding users and solving real problems with intuitive, user-friendly tools.
  + Daily use of **AI tools** (e.g. coding copilots, LLM-based design assistants, automation agents) and the ability to **integrate AI reasoning and automation into workflows** across coding, documentation, testing, and deployment.
  + Fluency in **Python** and (preferably) the **Django** framework, with experience managing large-scale production systems and building **REST APIs.**
  + **Strong communication and collaboration skills**: you’re proactive, listen carefully, and collaborate closely with product, design, engineering, and other stakeholders.
  + A passion for l**earning, experimenting**, and turning new AI tools into practical, repeatable workflows — always keeping **user value** at the core.

  **Nice to have:**

  + During your career you successfully mentored and coached engineers.
  + Experience with data products and its challenges.
  + Skill in demonstrating AI-driven productivity to peers and driving adoption within technical teams.**Why you’ll love it here:**
  + Flexible working hours and home-office
  + Internal shares program (EDPP)
  + Ergonomic workspace and cutting edge technology
  + Budget for job relevant training
  + Regular team events
  + Modern and stylish offices
  + Sustainable merch for all employees
  + Adverity Social Responsibility Days (+2 days paid off)
  + Public transportation ticket for Vienna

  The **minimum gross salary is €70,000**. In any case, we offer competitive salaries depending on your qualifications and experience.

  **Apply now** if you are ready to revolutionise the way businesses work with marketing data. We look forward to meeting you!

* ### **Service Support Specialist**
